subject: Silver Slugger Award
query: what is the silver slugger award
title: What is the Silver Slugger Award? 2026 winners announced Nov. 17
answer: The Silver Slugger Award goes to the best offensive player at each position in the American and National leagues. It has been presented since 1980 by Louisville Slugger maker Hillerich & Bradsby, and MLB managers and coaches vote. The 2026 winners will be announced on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026.
body:
Each team gets four votes, cast by its manager and three coaches, and voters cannot pick players from their own team. They weigh statistics such as OPS, OPS+, home runs, RBIs and batting average, along with "general impressions of a player's overall offensive value." Each league names 10 winners: catcher, first base, second base, third base, shortstop, three outfielders, designated hitter and a utility player, which was added in 2022. A team award for the best offensive club in each league began in 2023. The trophy is a three-foot bat plated with sterling silver.

Barry Bonds holds the record with 12 Silver Sluggers; Mike Piazza and Alex Rodriguez have 10 each. The Silver Slugger is the hitting counterpart of the Gold Glove, which honors defense and was announced on Nov. 1, 2026. The 2026 Silver Slugger finalists were announced on Nov. 2.
in_the_news: Louisville Slugger will announce the 2026 Silver Slugger winners on Nov. 17, 2026, after the finalists were revealed on Nov. 2.
